ALG

Application Layer Gateways

Application Layer Gateways are an optional part of firewall functionality.

Changing these settings can have an effect on the reliability of your 3rd party VoIP Service through the Sky Hub.


Please contact your 3rd party VoIP Service Provider for advice on configuring your VoIP device/application.

These settings will not impact your Sky Voice Service.
